description: Optimization and model settings for the final EATraj (Stage-2 warm-start joint) model reported in the manuscript.

optimization.lr_schedule: linear warmup for 5 epochs followed by cosine decay

initialization.source: Stage-1 relational checkpoint (Mamba-2 temporal encoder with relation modelling, joint=False)
initialization.note: Compatible tensors are loaded from the Stage-1 best checkpoint; optimizer state, RNG state, and epoch count are not restored. Joint response-dimension tensors absent from the Stage-1 checkpoint use their Stage-2 initialization.

checkpoint_selection.rule: minimum validation family-macro scene-minADE at the 5-second horizon
